name: Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes
title: Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes
description:
The Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. A Metric M22x1.5 to 10AN Banjo Bolt perfect for Oil Coolers or other tight-fitting areas. the banjo bolts are pre-drilled for safety wire to prevent accidental rotation. Includes the banjo fitting, banjo bolt, and washer pair.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
